primary.name: Assize
primary.shortDesc:
Beckon: Fel becomes unavailable
Each time a vassal attacks an enemy, they mark the enemy with their magic. The magical mark does not stack and changes when a different vassal attacks.
Magical marks from a vassal's Edict and Dominus skills stack. Edict and Dominus marks can only be consumed by another vassal's Edict or Dominus skills.
Each time an attack lands, there is a 10% chance for 1 imp to appear.
When a magical mark changes or marks are stacked, Assize has a 50% chance to activate and beckon 1 imp to charge and attack the enemy.
Beckoned Imp: Duration: 10 sec, Max Enemies Hit: 2, Damage: 190%, Number of Attacks: 2, disappears after 3 hits, Max Number of Imps: 10
Charging Imp: Damage: 160%, Number of Attacks: 2
primary.desc: Enemies are marked when attacked by a [Beckon] summon or their [Edict] and [Dominus] skills
details: Each [Beckon] summon applies a separate magic mark<bp_Marks applied from [Edict] and [Dominus] skills can only be consumed by another [Beckon] summon's [Edict] or [Dominus] skill_The marks stack and changes based on the [Beckon] summon who applied them_>
Upon successful attacks, there is a chance to summon an <tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/beckon-fel.png} tip={Beckon: Fel (1st Job)}> imp

When the mark changes or stacks, there is a chance that a summoned <tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/beckon-fel.png} tip={Beckon: Fel (1st Job)}> imp will charge towards the enemy and a mark is consumed
[<tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/beckon-fel.png} tip={Beckon: Fel (1st Job)}>]: This skill becomes a passive skill and imps are automatically summoned

primary.shortDesc: Automatically triggers on enemies within range if there are 30 imps that have been beckoned by Assize.\nMP Cost: 100, Creates 4 Imp Waves, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Damage: 383%, Number of Attacks: 5\nAssize Imp Normal Enemy Damage: +60% (additive)
primary.desc: When <tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/assize.png} tip={Assize (3rd Job)}> summons a set amount of <tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/beckon-fel.png} tip={Beckon: Fel (1st Job)}> imps, an additional attack is triggered
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases %Damage to regular monsters of <tt src={/class-icons/demon/lethe/assize.png} tip={Assize (3rd Job)}> imps by a flat amount
The additional attack prioritizes bosses with the higest Max HP first
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

primary.name: Proscribe
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 70, Condemns an enemy within a set range as a priority target
Upon condemning an enemy, your vassals teleport to the enemy's location and attack
Your vassals' search range increases when you proscribe an enemy. If they find no target within range, they will search for enemies around Lethe. The vassals' autonomous combat range from Lethe also increases.
If the Proscribed enemy leaves your vassals' search range, they will attack a different target. If the Proscribed enemy comes back into range, your vassals will target the enemy once more.
primary.desc: Applies a debuff to an enemy that causes [Beckon] summons to teleport and target that enemy
details: Debuff prioritizes bosses and enemies closest to the character
While debuff is applied, [Beckon] summon attack search range is increased
If the debuffed enemy leaves the [Beckon] summon's search range, summons will attack a different target
